notes: The room shell is 62% of an average frame, so its finish decides whether a
scene carries any specular cue. Across 88 rendered scenes, 81 had a shell
under 1% smooth and 6 were over 90%, with one in between.
The registry is bimodal at the material level: 82 of 100 materials have
almost no pixel that can hold a highlight and 13 are more than half smooth.
So what decides a scene is how many of its few shell slots drew one of those
13 -- and the fix is to say how often that should happen per role, rather
than to band the mean roughness, which excluded the glossy materials without
These rates are frequencies of real finishes: floors are frequently varnished
or tiled, walls occasionally satin, ceilings flat.
